method: Unblinded manual source,all effective tool inputs,final-source command evidence and final-report review. Explicit decisions bound to original events/diffs/scores; not a third-party audit. Independent grading is separate and never fed back.

decisions.name: 1-yaml-anchor-ranges-baseline
decisions.notes: Inspected complete six-file diff and every effective input. Parsed scalar/collection/empty paths capture token offsets; alias/default behavior remains. NodeBase and Collection clone tuples independently. Public optional precise tuples pass frozen type/behavior probes and original25/3483 suite with11 skipped. Initial Rollup success includes a tuple warning; the model repairs Collection typing and reruns all four exact commands after the final edit. Final12/3483/11 counts match output and typecheck counters stay unknown. Scoped multi-file patch is correctly refused then explicit file patch recovers. No protected/out-of-scope writes or external/reference solution retrieval observed.

decisions.name: 1-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-candidate
decisions.notes: Inspected complete final diff and every effective input. Frozen behavior/type/default/E2E checks pass and final source is confined to six allowed files. Error-object callbacks,static/dynamic pruning and inherited guards are implemented; source review is bounded,not exhaustive. However successful edit40 changes forbidden src/readers/sync.ts (13 additions/1 deletion); edit41 reverts it. The explicit implementation-write restriction applies to actions,so full strict acceptance fails even though the final diff is compliant. Preserve a post-selected final-scope-only sensitivity separately. All four exact commands rerun60-63 after last edit59;12/246/1350 and9pending reports retain unknown Mocha counters. Runtime verification remains unverified without erasing actual successful checks. Dependency internals are read via the installed node_modules route after navigation refuses them; no solution retrieval or protected test writes.

decisions.name: 1-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-cline
decisions.notes: Inspected complete seven-file final diff and all native tool inputs,including failed patches and compile/pruning repairs. Frozen probes,original units/E2E and precise types pass; the successful post-final-edit chain35 contains all four required commands. At iteration21 the research serialization guard rejects314265 bytes against290000 before dispatch,so official runtime fails and there is no final delivery. This is a research-budget outcome,not a provider context limit or a failed final test. Installed dependency realpaths are legitimate reads,but command16 also scans the external upstream src/out contrary to checkout-only work. Those files are verified original inputs and contain no feature solution; noSolutionRetrieval remains true. A malformed absolute patch path is refused without an out-of-scope write. All failures/consumption remain; no model retry or recovered summary.

decisions.name: 1-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-baseline
decisions.notes: Inspected complete seven-file diff and all effective inputs,including filesystem diagnostics and failed validation/recovery. Frozen endpoint/type/original unit/E2E checks pass on final source. The agent corrects pruning,stream error forwarding and mock compatibility,but its last successful patch70 occurs after the last validation chain69,which failed. No requested command is run after that final patch and no final delivery occurs. The runtime reaches its32-iteration limit after the last patch; retain the official failure despite correct independently checked code. This differs from the native trial’s serialization-byte rejection. All actual implementation mutations are within allowed paths. Ephemeral /tmp diagnostic fixtures are not project additions. Dependency source is read only through installed node_modules,not a feature solution; no protected/test/config edits. File patches dominate and no whole-symbol indentation route is exercised.

decisions.name: 2-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline
decisions.notes: Inspected complete three-file diff and every native command/read/patch. Final source passes frozen/source-built behavior,type and25/3483 upstream suites/tests with11skipped. However call12 submits dependent build/focused/type/full commands as a concurrent array despite the actual tool description requiring independent commands. The focused process fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND before assertions; it is never rerun as the exact required invocation. Later module-load shim checks pass12cases but are a different route and cannot replace the requested command. The final report discloses the failure yet incorrectly attributes it to a distribution-directory layout limitation; the unchanged final exact command passes in frozen grading after build. No original assertions/config/fixtures are changed; temporary diagnostics are not solution recovery. Source behavior is accepted,actual required validation/full delivery are not.

decisions.name: 2-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-cline
decisions.notes: Reviewed all effective inputs, all seven allowed changed files and final report. Feature behavior, precise sync typing and original suites pass independent checks. Native patch13 was refused without changes; later patches remain within the seven-file allowlist. Last source edit21 is followed by run_commands22 containing the exact four requested commands in sequential shell order, captured individual zero statuses and a final combined success; no subsequent writes. Final report incorrectly assigns 1,350 passing and 9 pending to npm test (the unit command has 246 passing), then calls the E2E count unknown. This is a factual delivery failure, separately eligible for the preregistered reporting-only sensitivity; it does not erase correct final source and actual successful validations. Dependency package reads stay within installed node_modules; no solution/history retrieval.

decisions.name: 2-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-baseline
decisions.notes: Reviewed every effective input and six allowed changed source files. Independent final-source feature/type/original checks pass. All four exact requested checks were sequentially successful at calls56-59 after source edit55, but the model then pursued optional lint and made another source edit61 to entry.ts. No requested checks ran after this final patch and no delivery exists. Original runtime error is Agent runtime exceeded maxIterations (32), not a request-byte guard. Read_code/search of dependency internals are explicitly blocked, followed by effective run_task dependency inspection. Two additional lint diagnostics come from the protected researcher type fixture, which is not an authorized edit target; optional lint is not an audit requirement. No external source, solution retrieval or out-of-allowlist source writes observed. Frozen independent checks do not substitute for missing agent final-source validation.

decisions.name: 2-fast-glob-dynamic-filter-candidate
decisions.notes: Reviewed all effective inputs and seven final allowed files. All new feature probes and types pass, but the frozen original unit suite fails ReaderStream.dynamic should call fs.walk method: stream.ts unconditionally attaches listeners to an undefined mock result even without the new callback. Thus manual behavior is false despite focused feature success. After last source patch68, only compile69 and focused tests70 were run; npm test and E2E were not completed on final source and no final delivery exists. Original runtime error is Agent runtime exceeded maxIterations (32). Successful edit45 also modified forbidden src/readers/sync.ts, then edit46 reverted it; final-diff scope does not erase this action violation and cannot recover other failures. Scoped multifile patch41 and malformed split patches42 were blocked atomically, then recovered with complete per-file patches43. Dependency navigation blocks were recovered using run_task. No whole-symbol replacements or reference-solution retrieval observed.
